about.title: About SHANY Living
about.subtitle: A premium Tel Aviv furniture showroom focused on customizable sofas, modern furniture and personal service.
about.storyFirst: We start with your space, not a catalog. Bring measurements or a photo of your room and our team maps the right model, structure, fabric and color combination for how you actually live.
about.storySecond: Every selection is packaged into a single WhatsApp summary, so you can review comfort, delivery timing and final details with one person from first visit to installation.
